name: FxLens
description: FXLens is a mobile trading assistant built with React Native and Appwrite, offering automated chart generation, cloud-synced analysis storage, secure authentication, and daily analysis limits. It streamlines market preparation by enabling traders to capture chart data and structure insights efficiently across iOS and Android.

name: Spillmetrics
description: Spillmetrics is a progressive web application for tracking and analyzing trading performance. It features trade journaling, analytics visualization, offline support, and persistent data storage, built on a modular React architecture optimized for handling large datasets.

name: PerfectPlace
techUsed: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase, Cloud Functions
description: PerfectPlace is a cross-platform property discovery and rental booking app built with React Native. It features real-time property listings, user authentication, location-based search, media-rich property pages, and Firebase-backed data syncing for consistent performance across Web, iOS, and Android.

name: CareConnect
techUsed: React Native, TypeScript, Appwrite, REST APIs
description: CareConnect is a mobile healthcare coordination app designed for caregivers and families. Built with React Native, it includes secure onboarding, appointment scheduling, symptom logging, caregiver communication tools, and encrypted cloud storage integrated through Appwrite and REST APIs.

name: Eventark
description: Eventark is an event creation and sharing platform built with Next.js, offering server-side rendering, secure event links, attendee tracking, and payment record management. It utilizes dynamic routing and optimized static generation for fast performance.

name: Zainab Wahab
description: A motion-focused portfolio built with React and GSAP, featuring scroll-triggered animations, component-based transitions, and optimized media loading to showcase visual design projects interactively.

name: AITI
description: AITI is a Vue.js-based educational platform offering structured course pages, curriculum modules, user enrollment flows, and reusable UI components. It is optimized for fast content delivery and scalable program expansion across multiple tech disciplines.

name: Support Widget (Open Source)
description: An embeddable support widget built as a standalone React component, handling form validation, message dispatching, and custom styling through scoped CSS. Designed for effortless integration via script embed or component import with no backend setup required.

name: Riltee
description: Riltee is a real-estate investment platform built with Next.js, featuring dynamic property listings, ROI projections, secure onboarding flows, and data-driven pages rendered using server-side techniques for speed and SEO performance.

name: Talentx
description: TalentX is a film financing marketplace built with Next.js, supporting dynamic project listings, pitch pages, and investor interest tracking through responsive, modular SCSS-styled components.

name: Invoice Tool
description: A lightweight invoice generator developed in React, featuring dynamic item rows, automatic calculations, printable invoice layouts, and a clean controlled-component architecture.

name: Greedy Hunter
description: A grid-based browser game built in Vue.js, implementing reactive game state, collision detection, timed movement updates, and optimized re-render cycles for smooth, event-driven gameplay.
